W3VerticalPolicy.description: Defender P0 (first move c1) or P1 (after P0 initial action); whenever attacker first claims lower of an available standard (r0,r1),(r2,r3),... pair, defender immediately claims upper member. Otherwise defender takes leftmost currently legal cell; attacker cannot own both members of a pair, hence cannot win vertically for K4; width3 has zero horizontal/diagonal K4 windows.
